items.t: Circular canvas, the composition curving to fill it.
Oval, portrait orientation, like an old locket.
Wide cinema proportion, roughly twenty one to nine.
Four to five, the proportion of a printed photograph.
A perfect square with a hand drawn border inside it, the image bleeding past the border in one place.
Postcard proportion, landscape, with a thin white margin all round.
Postage stamp proportion, small and upright, with a perforated edge.
A tall narrow banner, roughly one to four, read top to bottom.
Double page spread proportion with a visible gutter down the middle.
An irregular torn shape, as though cut roughly from a larger sheet.
Arched top, flat bottom, like a window.
A horizontal strip only as tall as it needs to be, cropped hard top and bottom.
Book cover proportion with a spine edge implied on the left.
Badge proportion. A circle inside a square with the corners doing nothing.
